decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer sits at the core of the firm's established hardware line and was promoted on the home page, so keeping it costs little relative to its strategic value.
The numbering software module costs little to maintain and supports the firm's serialization and traceability direction, so the option is worth holding open.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the core technology into a broad application niche, its upkeep is low, and nothing indicates its value has failed to materialize.
The free decoding app is cheap to maintain and complements traceability offerings, though as a successor app it could be replaced or merged again.
Inline code verification is central to the firm's push toward end-to-end traceability, so further commitment rather than abandonment is warranted.
The layout design software underpins common operation across the firm's systems and was featured on the home page, making it a low-cost option with ongoing value.
